data.description:
Goal:
Extend Diffinite's managed receive policy so every Knots protocol ref has server-enforced ownership and old deployments cannot reopen frozen refs.

Verification:
1. Run real-bare-repo pre-receive tests for credential-scoped inboxes, service-only canonical refs, freeze markers, deletion, recreation, and force-update denial.
2. Run rollback-floor tests proving an older application cannot reinstall a permissive hook.
3. Ship through the normal Diffinite rail and read back the installed hook plus live rejection/acceptance probes.

Constraints:
Use existing Diffinite hosts, persistent repo storage, deployment rail, and persona capability text array. Add no production database schema migration, host, DNS, TLS, or network dependency.
